scope: Focused single-CPU warm comparison. Denied-pidfd process inherits an actual seccomp ENOSYS filter, verified by the launcher before Node starts; readiness process uses the normal kernel. Twelve paired samples interleave all six native/SDK/Rust orders. Checked output/status; parent CPU includes Rust reactor, excludes child CPU. Separate diagnostic, not the complete seven-workload/default-pool acceptance run or a cross-platform guarantee.
